segments.vv72:1.3: Āmuttahatthābharaṇo yasassī, dibbe vimānamhi yathāpi candimā.
segments.vv72:2.1: “Dibbā ca vīṇā pavadanti vagguṃ, aṭṭhaṭṭhakā sikkhitā sādhurūpā;
segments.vv72:2.3: Dibbā ca kaññā tidasacarā uḷārā, naccanti gāyanti pamodayanti.
segments.vv72:3.3: Kenāsi evaṃ jalitānubhāvo, vaṇṇo ca te sabbadisā pabhāsatī”ti.
segments.vv72:4.1: So devaputto attamano … pe … yassa kammassidaṃ phalaṃ.
segments.vv72:5.5: Annañca pānañca pasannacitto, sakkacca dānaṃ vipulaṃ adāsiṃ.
segments.vv72:6.1: “Tena metādiso vaṇṇo … pe … vaṇṇo ca me sabbadisā pabhāsatī”ti.

lines: “Sakuṇḍalī” tipi pāṭho, sadisaṃ kuṇḍalaṃ sakuṇḍalaṃ, taṃ assa atthīti sakuṇḍalī, yuttakuṇḍalī aññamaññañca tuyhañca anucchavikakuṇḍalīti attho.
Taṇhakkhayūpapanneti taṇhakkhayaṃ arahattaṃ, nibbānameva vā upagate, adhigatavanteti attho.
